text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Níor gortaíodh Zayat sa timpiste.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Maidir leis an staid airgeadais dhomhanda, lean Zapatero ar aghaidh ag rá gur "cuid den gheilleagar an córas airgeadais, cuid ríthábhachtach.“
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Tá géarchéim airgeadais bliana againn, a raibh an nóiméad is géire aici le dhá mhí anuas, agus is dóigh liom anois go bhfuil na margaí airgeadais ag tosú ag téarnamh."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: An tseachtain seo caite, d'fhógair Naked News go raibh siad chun a sholáthar teanga idirnáisiúnta a mhéadú go mór i dtaca le tuairisciú nuachta, le trí chraoladh nua.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Agus tuairisciú i mBéarla agus i Seapáinis ar bun ann cheana, tá cláir Spáinnise, Iodáilise, agus Chóiréise don teilifís, don ghréasáin, agus do ghléasanna móibíleacha á lainseáil ag an eagraíocht dhomhanda.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Buíochas le dia níor tharla rud ar bith domsa ach tháinig mé ar láthair adhfhuafar agus daoine ag iarraidh fuinneoga a bhriseadh le héalú.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Bhí daoine ag bualadh na bpánaí le cathaoireacha, ach níorbh fhéidir na fuinneoga a bhriseadh.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Bhris ceann de na pánaí ar deireadh, agus thosaigh siad ag éalú amach an fhuinneog," a dúirt Franciszek Kowal, a tháinig slán.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Scaoileann réaltaí solas agus teas de bharr an fhuinnimh a dhéanamh nuair a chumasctar nó nuair a chomhtháthaítear adaimh hidrigine le chéile chun dúile níos troime a dhéanamh.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Tá eolaithe ag obair chun imoibreoir a chruthú a fhéadfaidh fuinneamh a dhéanamh sa tslí chéanna.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Mar sin féin, is deacair an fhadhb seo a fhuascailt agus tógfaidh sé go leor blianta sula mbeidh imoibreoirí comhleá úsáideacha ar an bhfód.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Teannas dromchla a choimeádann an tsnáthaid chruach ag snámhaíl ar bharr an uisce.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Is é an rud is cúis le teannas dromchla móilíní uisce ar dhromchla an uisce a bheith faoi tharraingt láidir dá chéile níos mó ná do na móilíní aeir os a gcionn.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Déanann na móilíní uisce craiceann dofheicthe ar dhromchla an uisce ionas gur féidir le rudaí cosúil leis an tsnáthaid snámh ar bharr an uisce.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Tá ciumhais dhúbailte agus log cuasach eararthu ar lann scátaí oighir na linne seo. Tugann an dá chiumhais seo greim níos fearr ar an oighear, fiú nuair a chlaontar iad.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Ós rud é go bhfuil bun na lainne beagáinín cuartha, dé réir mar a chlaontar an lann ar thaobh amháin nó taobh eile, bíonn cuar ar an imeall a thagann i dteagmháil leis an oighear freisin.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Cuireann sé seo an scátálaí ag casadh. Má chlaonann na scátaí ar dheis, casann an scátálaí ar dheis, má chlaonann na scátaí ar chlé, casann an scátálaí ar chlé.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Chun filleadh ar an leibhéal fuinnimh a bhí acu roimhe seo, ní mór dóibh fáil réidh leis an bhfuinneamh breise a fuair siad ón solas.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Déanann siad amhlaidh trí cháithnín bídeach solais ar a dtugtar "fótón" a astú.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Tugann eolaithe "astú spreagtha radaíochta" ar an bpróiseas seo toisc gurb é an solas geal a spreagann na hadaimh, as a n-astaítear fótón solais, agus is cineál radaíochta é solas.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Taispeánann an chéad phictiúr eile na hadaimh agus fótóin á n-astú acu. Ar ndóigh, i ndáiríre tá fótóin i bhfad níos lú ná iad siúd atá sa phictiúr.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Tá fótóin níos lú fiú ná an t-ábhar as a bhfuil adaimh déanta!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: I ndiaidh na gcéadta uair an chloig ag feidhmiú, sa deireadh éiríonn an filiméad sa bholgán caite agus ní oibreoidh an bolgán solais a thuilleadh.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Caithfear bolgán solais nua a fháil ansin. Caithfear an bolgán solais nua a chur isteach go cúramach.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Ar dtús, ní foláir go gcasfar as an lasc don daingneán solais, é sin nó dícheangail an cábla.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: An chúis leis seo ná gur féidir le leictreachas a shreabhann isteach sa soicéad mar a shuíonn an chuid mhiotalach den bholgán turraing mhór leictreach a thabhairt duit má theagmhaíonn tú leis an taobh istigh den soicéad nó le bonn miotail an bholgáin agus cuid de fós sa soicéad.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Is é an croí, a steallann an fhuil, príomhbhall an chóras imshruthaithe.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Imíonn fuil ón gcroí i bhfeadáin ar a dtugtar artairí agus tagann ar ais chuig an gcroí i bhfeadáin ar a dtugtar féitheacha. Tugtar ribeadáin ar na feadáin is lú.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Ní hamháin go mbíodh fiacla an trícheireatóip in ann duilleoga a mheilt, ach mheilidís craobhacha agus fréamhacha righne freisin fiú amháin.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Tá eolaithe ann a shíleann go n-itheadh an Triceratops cíocáidí, ar cineál planda iad a bhí coitianta sa Tréimhse Chailceach.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Tá cuma an chrainn bhig pailme ar na plandaí seo, tá coróin de dhuilleoga géara deilgneacha orthu.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: D'fhéadfaí gur úsáideadh Trícheireatóp a ghob láidir leis na duilleoga a bhaint roimh an stoc a ithe.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Áitíonn eolaithe eile go bhfuil na plandaí seo an-nimhiúil agus mar sin ní dócha gur ith dineasáir ar bith iad, cé gur féidir leis an spadán agus ainmhithe eile cosúil leis an bpearóid (a shíolraíonn ó na dineasáir) inniu duilleoga nó torthaí nimhiúla a ithe.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Conas a tharraingeodh domhantarraingt Io orm? Dá seasfá ar dhromchla Io, bheifeá níos éadroime ná mar a bhíonn tú ar an Domhan.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Duine atá 200 punt (90kg) meáchain ar Domhan, bheadh sé/sí thart ar 36 punt (16kg) ar Io. Mar sin, bíonn éifeacht an imtharraingthe níos lú ort, ar ndóigh.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Níl screamh ar féidir seasamh air ag an nGrian, mar atá ag an Domhan. As gáis, tine agus plasma amháin atá an Ghrian déanta.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Éiríonn an gás níos tanaí de réir mar a imíonn tú níos faide ó lár na Gréine.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: An fótasféar a thugtar ar an gcuid is faide amuigh a fheicimid nuair a fhéachaimid ar an nGrian, a chiallaíonn "liathróid solais".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Tuairim is trí mhíle bliain ina dhiaidh, sa bhliain 1610, d'úsáid an réalteolaí Iodálach Galileo Galilei teileascóp le tabhairt faoi deara go mbaineann céimeanna le Véineas, go díreach mar a bhíonn ag an ngealach.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Tarlaíonn céimeanna toisc nach soilsítear ach an taobh de Véineas (nó den Ghealach) atá os comhair na Gréine. Thacaigh céimeanna Véineas le teoiric Copernicus go dtéann na pláinéid timpeall na Gréine.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Ansin, cúpla bliain ina dhiaidh sin, i 1639, scrúdaigh réalteolaí Sasanach darb ainm Jeremiah Horrocks idirthuras Véineas.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Tar éis an Danelaw a athghabháil tháinig tréimhse fhada síochána ar Shasana.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Bhí an cabhlach Lochlannach a tháinig os comhair Ethelred i 991 níos mó ná aon chabhlach ó aimsir Guthrum céad bliain ó shin.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Olaf Trygvasson a bhí i gceannas ar an gcabhlach seo, Ioruach a raibh sé d'uaillmhian aige a thír a athghabháil ó fhorlámhas na Danmhairge.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Tar éis céimeanna ar gcúl go míleata ar dtús, d'éirigh le Ethelred comhaontú a dhéanamh le Olaf, ar fhill seisean ar an Iorua chun a ríocht a ghabháil, rud nár éirigh go hiomlán leis.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Is é Hangeul an t-aon aibítir ar ceapadh d'aon ghnó é a úsáideann daoine le fonn laethúil. Ceapadh an aibítir i 1444 le linn réimeas Rí Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Ba é Rí Sejong an cheathrú rí de ríshliocht Joseon agus ard-mheas air thar cuid mhaith eile.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Ar dtús thug sé an t-ainm Hunmin Jeongeum ar an aibítir Hangeul, rud a chiallaíonn "na fuaimeanna cearta leis an pobal a theagasc".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Tá go leor teoiricí ann faoin tslí ar tháinig ann don Sanscrait. Teoiric amháin is ea gur teanga í a thug inimircigh Airianacha ón iarthar isteach san India.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Is teanga ársa í an tSanscrait agus tá sí inchomparáide leis an Laidin a labhraítear san Eoraip.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: I Sanscrait a scríobhadh an leabhar is luaithe is eol ar domhan. Tar éis tiomsú na n-Upainisead, chuaigh Sanscrait i léig i ngeall ar ordlathas.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Is teanga an-chasta agus saibhir í an tSanscrait, a bhí mar fhoinse do go leor nua-theangacha Indiacha, díreach mar is í an Laidin foinse do theangacha Eorpacha mar an Fhraincis agus an Spáinnis.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Agus an cath ar son na Fraince thart, thosaigh an Ghearmáin ag ullmhú chun ionradh a dhéanamh ar oileán na Breataine.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Thug an Ghearmáin an códainm "Operation Sealion" ar an ionsaí. Cailleadh an chuid is mó de na trom-uirlisí troda agus soláthairtí de chuid arm na Breataine nuair a d'aistrigh sé amach ó Dunkirk, agus bhí an t-arm sách lag dá bharr sin.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ach fós bhí an Cabhlach Ríoga i bhfad níos láidre ná Cabhlach na Gearmáine (“Kriegsmarine”) agus bhí sé ar a chumas aon loingeas ionraidh curtha trasna an Mhuir nIocht a scriosadh.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Mar sin féin, ní raibh ach fíorbheagán de longa an Chabhlaigh Ríoga sna háiteanna ina rabhthas ag súil le hionradh, toisc go raibh eagla ar na haimiréil go ndéanfadh na Gearmánaigh ionsaí aeir a bhádh iad.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tosóimid le míniú i dtaobh pleananna na hIodáile. Bhí an Iodáil go príomha mar "deartháir beag" na Gearmáine agus na Seapáine.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Bhí airm níos laige agus cabhlach níos laige cé go raibh ceithre long nua díreach tógtha acu roimh thús an chogaidh.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Ba iad príomhspriocanna na hIodáile tíortha na hAfraice. Chun na tíortha sin a ghabháil, bheadh ​​ceap lainseála trúpaí ag teastáil uathu, ionas go bhféadfadh trúpaí a sheoladh trasna na Meánmhara agus ionradh a dhéanamh ar an Afraic.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Chuige sin, níor mhór dóibh fáil réidh le bunáiteanna agus longa na Breataine san Éigipt. Seachas na gníomhartha sin, ní raibh sé beartaithe go ndéanfadh longa cogaidh na hIodáile aon ní eile.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Anois an tSeapáin. Ba thír oileáin í an tSeapáin, díreach cosúil leis an mBreatain.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Tá fomhuireáin ceaptha le taisteal faoi uisce, agus fanacht ann ar feadh achar fada.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Baineadh úsáid as formhuireáin sa Chéad agus sa Dara Cogadh Domhanda. Bhí siad an-mhall an uair sin agus bhí an-teorainn lena raon scaoilte.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: I dtús an chogaidh thaistil siad den chuid is mó ar bharr na farraige, ach de réir mar a forbraíodh radar thosaigh sé ag éirí níos cruinne agus b’éigean do na fomhuireáin dul faoi uisce ionas nach bhfeicfí iad.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Tugadh U-bháid ar fhomhuireáin na Gearmáine. Bhíodh na Gearmánaigh an-éifeachtach sa loingseoireacht agus ag oibriú a gcuid fomhuireán.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Mar gheall ar an gcaoi ar éirigh leo le fomhuireáin, ní chuirtear iontaoibh sna Gearmánaigh gur ceart mórán a bheith acu tar éis an chogaidh.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Is ea! Tá an Rí Tútancáman, a dtugtar an "Rí Tút" nó "An Rí Buachalla", ar dhuine de na ríthe Éigipteacha ársa is iomráití sa lá atá inniu ann.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Suimiúil go leor, níor ceapadh go raibh sé an-tábhachtach san am ársa agus níor taifeadadh é ar fhormhór na liostaí na ríthe ársa.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Rinneadh duine cáiliúil as nuair a aimsíodh an tuama sa bhliain 1922. Cé gur robáladh go leor tuamaí san am atá thart, fágadh an tuama seo beagnach mar a bhí.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Tá bail mhaith ar mhórchuid de na hearraí a bhí curtha in éineacht le Tutankhamun lena n-áirítear na mílte déantán déanta as miotal lómhar agus tearc-chlocha.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: D'fhág teacht na rothaí spóca go raibh carbaid na nAisiriach níos éadroime, níos gasta agus níos ullmhaithe chun dul chun tosaigh ar shaighdiúirí agus ar charbaid eile.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Bhíodh saigheada a gcrosbhoghanna marfacha in ann dul trí chathéide shaighdiúrí an naimhde. Timpeall 1000 R.C., thug na hAisiriaigh isteach an chéad mharcra.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Arm a throideann ar muin capaill is ea marcra. Níor ceapadh fós an diallait, mar sin throidtí an marcra Aisiriach ar a gcapaill gan diallait.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Tá aithne againn ar go leor polaiteoirí, eolaithe agus ealaíontóirí Gréagacha. B’fhéidir gurb é an duine is mó aithne ar an gcultúr seo ná Homer, an file dall finscéalach, a chum dhá mhórshaothar de litríocht na Gréige: na dánta An tÍliad agus An Odaisé.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Tá meas ar Sofaicléas agus Arastafainéas i gcónaí mar scríbhneoirí drámaí agus meastar a gcuid drámaí a bheith ar na saothair litríochta domhanda is breátha.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Gréagach eile mór le rá is é an matamaiticeoir Pythagoras, ar thuill sé is mó clú as a theoirim cháiliúil faoin ngaolta a bhaineann le taobhanna na dtriantán dronuilleach.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Tá meastacháin éagsúla ann ar líon na ndaoine a labhraíonn Hiondúis. Meastar go bhfuil sé idir an dara agus an ceathrú teanga is forleithne a labhraítear ar domhan.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Bíonn líon na gcainteoirí dúchais éagsúil ag brath ar cibé ar cuireadh canúintí a bhfuil dlúthghaol eatarthu san áireamh.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: De réir meastachán tá raon idir 340 milliún agus 500 milliún cainteoirí ann, agus tá chomh hard le 800 milliún duine a bhfuil tuiscint ar an teanga acu.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Bíonn cosúlachtaí sa stór focal idir Hindi agus Urdu ach iad éagsúil mar scríbhneoireacht; sa chaint laethúil, bíonn tuiscint idir chainteoirí an dá theanga de ghnáth.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Timpeall na 15ú haoise, bhí tuaisceart na hEastóine faoi thionchar mór cultúrtha na Gearmáine.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Theastaigh ó roinnt manaigh Ghearmánacha Dia a thabhairt níos gaire don chosmhuintir, agus mar sin chum siad teanga litriúil na hEastóine.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Bhí sé bunaithe ar aibítir na Gearmáinise agus cuireadh carachtar amháin "Õ/õ" leis.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Le himeacht ama, rinneadh comhtháthú ar go leor focal ar tógadh ón nGearmáinis iad. Ba é sin tús na heagnaíochta.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ba é an traidisiún go rachadh an t-oidhre ar an ríocht díreach isteach san arm tar éis an scoil a fhágáil.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Mar sin féin, chuaigh Séarlas chuig an ollscoil ag Coláiste na Tríonóide, Cambridge áit a rinne sé staidéir ar antraipeolaíocht agus seandálaíocht, agus ar Stair ina dhiaidh sin, agus bhain sé 2:2 amach (céim dara honóracha íochtarach).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Ba é Séarlas an chéad duine de Theaghlach Ríoga na Breataine ar bronnadh céim air.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Clúdaítear 3% den tír leis an Tuirc Eorpach (oirthear Thrace nó Rumelia i leithinis na mBalcánach).
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: 1,600 ciliméadar (1,000 míle) ar fhad agus 800 km (500 míle) ar leithead atá i gcríoch na Tuirce, agus tá cruth dronuilleogach air, nach mór.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Clúdaíonn achar na Tuirce, lena n-áirítear lochanna, 783,562 ciliméadar cearnach (300,948 míle cearnach), a bhfuil 755,688 ciliméadar cearnach (291,773 míle cearnach) díobh in iardheisceart na hÁise agus 23,764 ciliméadar cearnach (9,174 míle cearnach) san Eoraip.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Ciallaíonn achar na Tuirce go bhfuil sé ar an 37ú tír is mó ar domhan, agus í chomh mór leis an bhFrainc agus an Ríocht Aontaithe i dteannta a chéile.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Tá An Tuirc timpeallaithe ag farraigí ar thrí thaobh: an Muir Aeigéach taobh thiar, an Mhuir Dhubh ó thuaidh agus an Mheánmhuir ó dheas.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Tá stair fada ag Lucsamburg ach is i 1839 a bhain siad a saoirse amach.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Bhain codanna den Bheilg mar atá sí inniu le Luxembourg, tráth, ach tháinig siad chun bheith mar chuid den Bheilg tar éis Réabhlóid na Beilge sna 1830í.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Tá iarracht déanta ag Lucsamburg fanacht neodrach ach bhí an tír gafa ag an Ghearmáin sa Chéad agus sa Dara Cogadh Domhanda.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: In 1957 ba í Lucsamburg ceann de na bunaitheoirí den eagraíocht ar a dtugtar an tAontas Eorpach inniu.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Is fothrach dúin agus mainistir Búdaíoch é an Drukgyal Dzong sa chuid uachtarach de Cheantar Paro (i Sráidbhaile Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Deirtear gur chruthaigh Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel an dún i 1649 le comóradh a dhéanamh ar a bhua ar na fórsaí Tibéadacha-Mongólacha.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: In 1951, ba chúis le tine nár fágadh ach cuid de na hiarsmaí an Drukgyal Dzong, mar shampla íomhá de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: I ndiaidh an dóiteáin, cuireadh an dún faoi chaomhnú agus chosaint, agus é fágtha mar cheann de na mór rudaí spéisiúla sa Bhútáin a mheallann go leor cuairteoirí.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: I gcaitheamh an 18ú haois, tháinig an Chambóid faoi bhrú idir dhá chomharsa chumhachtacha, an Téalainn agus Vítneam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Rinne na Téalannaigh ionradh ar an gCambóid arís agus arís eile san 18ú haois agus i 1772 scrios siad Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Sna blianta deireanacha den 18ú haois rinne na Vítneamaigh ionradh ar an Chambóid freisin.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Tá ocht déag faoin gcéad de mhuintir Veiniséala dífhostaithe, agus oibríonn formhór na ndaoine atá fostaithe sa gheilleagar neamhfhoirmiúil.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: San earnáil seirbhísí a oibríonn dhá thrian de mhuintir Veiniséala a théann ag obair, sa tionsclaíocht a oibríonn beagnach aon cheathrú agus sa talmhaíocht aon chúigiú.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Is tionscal tábhachtach do mhuintir Veiniséala an ola, de bhrí gur glan-easpórtálaí ola í an tír, ina ainneoin sin, ní oibríonn ach aon faoin gcéad den phobal i dtionscal an ola.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Sna laethanta tosaigh i neamhspleáchas an náisiúin, chuidigh saineolaíocht Ghairdíní na Lus Shingeapór leis an oileán a chlaochlú ina Chathair Ghairdíneach thrópaiceach.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: In 1981, roghnaíodh Vanda Miss Joaquim, hibrideach magairlín, mar bhláth náisiúnta an náisiúin.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Gach bliain thart ar mhí Dheireadh Fómhair bogann beagnach 1.5 milliún luibhiteoir ó na cnoic thuaidh i dtreo na mánna theas, ag dul trasna Abhainn Mara, chun leas a bhaint as séasúr na báistí.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Agus ar ais ansin ó thuaidh, tríd an iarthar, ag trasnú abhainn Mara athuair, tar éis shéasúr na báistí thart ar mhí Aibreáin.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: I réigiún an Serengeti gheofar Páirc Náisiúnta Serengeti, Limistéar faoi Chaomhnú Ngorongoro agus Tearmann Géim Maswa sa Tansáin agus Tearmann Géim Náisiúnta Maasai Mara sa Chéinia.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Tá gnáthscileanna agus scileanna traidisiúnta de dhíth le foghlaim conas meáin idirghníomhach a chruthú, chomh maith le huirlisí foghlamtha i ranganna idirghníomhacha (scéalchlárú, eagarthóireacht fuaime agus físe, scéalaíocht, srl.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Éilíonn dearadh idirghníomhach go ndéanann tú athmheasúnú ar na buntuiscintí atá agat faoi tháirgeadh na meán agus go bhfoghlaimíonn tú beith ag smaoineamh ar bhealaí neamhlíneacha.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Éilíonn dearadh idirghníomhach go nascann comhpháirteanna tionscadail lena chéile, ach go mbíonn ciall leis mar aonán ar leith freisin.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Is é an míbhuntáiste a bhaineann le lionsaí súmála ná go bhfuil castacht fhócasach agus líon na n-eilimintí lionsa atá riachtanach chun raon fad fócasach a bhaint amach i bhfad níos mó ná i gcás lionsaí príomha.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Tá an fhadhb seo ag maolú de bhrí go mbaineann déantóirí lionsaí caighdeáin níos airde amach i dtáirgeadh lionsaí.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Cumasaíonn sé sin do lionsaí súmála pictiúir a tháirgeadh atá ar cháilíocht atá inchomparáide leis an gcaighdeán a bhaintear amach le lionsaí a bhfuil fad fócasach seasta acu.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Míbhuntáiste eile atá le lionsaí zúmála is ea go mbaineann uas-chró (luas) an lionsa níos lú leo de ghnáth.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Ciallaíonn sé gur deacair lionsaí súmála neamhchostasacha a úsáid faoi sholas íseal gan splanc.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Ceann de na fadhbanna is coitianta agus tú ag iarraidh scannán a thiontú go formáid DVD ná an ró-scan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Is chun an pobal i gcoitinne a shásamh a dhéantar formhór na dteilifíseán.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Is mar gheall air sin go mbíonn na ciumhaiseanna gearrtha ar an mbarr, ag an mbun agus ar na taobhanna ar gach rud a fheiceann tú ar TV.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Déantar amhlaidh le cinntiú go gclúdaíonn an pictiúr an scáileán iomlán. Ró-scanadh a thugtar air seo.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Ar an drochuair, nuair a dhéanann tú DVD, is dóichí ná a mhalairt go ngearrfar a theorainneacha, leis, agus má tá fotheidil ar an bhfíseán atá róghar don bhun, ní thaispeánfar iad ina n-iomláine.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Spreagadh don tsamhlaíocht le fada an lá is ea an caisleán meánaoiseach traidisiúnta, spreagann sé pictiúir den ghiústáil, d'fhéastaí móra agus den niachas Artúrach.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Fiú agus a bheith ag seasamh i measc fothracha atá míle bliain d'aois is éasca fuaimeanna agus bolaithe na gcathanna fadó a shamhlú, is beag nach féidir greadadh na gcrúb ar na doirneoga a chloisteáil agus an eagla ag teacht aníos ó phoill na ndoinsiún a bhraith.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ach an bhfuil ár samhlaíocht bunaithe ar an bhfírinne? Cén fáth ar tógadh caisleáin ar dtús báire? Conas a dearadh agus a tógadh iad?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Gnáthchaisleán sa tréimhse sin ab ea Caisleán Kirby Muxloe cé gur teach daingnithe é níos mó ná fíorchaisleán.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Ní bheadh a fuinneoga gloinithe móra agus ballaí tanaí ábalta ionsaí fíochmhar a sheasamh i bhfad.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Sna 1480idí, nuair a chuir an Tiarna Hastings tús leis an tógáil, bhí an tír réasúnta síochánta agus ní raibh gá le cosaint ach i gcoinne bandaí beaga de mharaithe mara.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Ba chóras é cothromaíocht na cumhachta inar fhéach tíortha Eorpacha le ceannas náisiúnta gach ceann de na stáit Eorpacha a choimeád.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Ba é an coincheap ná go raibh ar náisiúin uile na hEorpa iarracht a dhéanamh náisiún amháin a chosc ó dhul i gcumhacht, agus dá bhrí sin is minic a d’athraigh rialtais náisiúnta a gcomhghuaillíochtaí chun an chothromaíocht a choinneáil.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ba é Cogadh Chomharbas na Spáinne an chéad chogadh inarbh é cothromaíocht na cumhachta an phríomhábhar.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Ba athrú tábhachtach é seo, de bhrí nach bhféadfadh cumhachtaí Eorpacha ligean orthu níos mó gur cogadh reiligiúnach a bhí ann. Mar sin, ba é Cogadh na dTríocha Bliain an cogadh deireanach ar tugadh cogadh reiligiúnach air.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Scriosadh teampall Artaimíse ag Eifeasas ar an 21 Iúil, 356 R.Ch. i ngníomh coirlosctha a rinne Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: De réir an scéil, ba é clú agus cáil a thuilleamh dó féin ar ais nó ar éigean a thug spreagadh dó. D'fhógair na hEifeasaigh, agus iad ar mire, go raibh cosc ar thaifead a dhéanamh riamh ar ainm Herostratus.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Bhreac Strabo, an staraí Gréagach, nóta den ainm níos déanaí, agus sin an tslí arb eol dúinn é inniu. Scriosadh an teampaill an oíche a rugadh Alastar Mór.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Thairg Alexander, mar rí, íoc as an teampall a atógáil, ach diúltaíodh dá thairiscint. Níos déanaí, i ndiaidh bhás Alexander, atógadh an teampall in 323 RCR.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Bí cinnte go bhfuil do lámh chomh scaoilte agus is féidir fad a bhuaileann sé na nótaí ar fad mar is ceart - chomh maith le sin déan iarracht gan mórán gluaiseachta breise a dhéanamh le do mhéara.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ní thuirseoidh tú tú féin ar an tslí seo, ach a laghad is féidir. Cuimhnigh nach gá na heochracha a bhualadh go dian chun airde bhreise a fháil faoi mar is gá ar an bpianó.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Chun airde bhreise a fháil ar an mbosca ceoil, úsáideann tú na boilg le brú nó luas níos airde.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Is é atá i gceist le misteachas ná comaoineach le, aitheantas le, nó feasacht chomhfhiosach ar réaltacht deiridh, diagacht, fírinne spioradálta, nó Dia.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Lorgaíonn an creidmheach eispéireas díreach, iomas, nó léargas ar réaltacht Dé/an dé nó na ndéithe.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Cloíonn an lucht leanúna le bealaí áirithe maireachtála, nó le cleachtaidh atá beartaithe leis na heispéiris sin a chothú.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Is féidir idirdhealú a dhéanamh idir misteachas agus cineálacha eile creidimh agus adhartha reiligiúnaí i ngeall ar an mbéim sa mhisteachas ar thaithí dhíreach phearsanta ar staideanna uathúla comhfhiosachta, go háirithe staideanna atá síochánta, léirsteanach, beannaithe nó fiú eacstaiseach.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Is reiligiún é an Suíceachas ó fho-ilchríoch na hIndia. Tháinig ann dó i réigiún Punjab i rith an 15ú haois de bharr scoilt seicteach laistigh den traidisiún Hiondúch.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Is reiligiún ann féin é an Suíceachas, dar le Suícigh, bíodh is go n-admhaíonn siad a fhréamhacha agus a thraidisiúin Hiondúcha.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Gurmat, an focal Puinseábach ar "slí an ghúrú" a thugann Suícigh ar a reiligiún. Is gné bhunúsach de gach reiligiún Indiach é an gúrú ach tá sé chomh tábhachtach sin sa Suíceachas gurb é croí chreideamh na Suíceach é.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: An Gúrú Nanak (1469–1539) a bhunaigh an reiligiún sa 15ú haois. Tháinig naoi ngúrú eile i gcomharbacht air.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: I mí an Mheithimh 1956, tástáladh gealltanais Krushchev nuair a d'iompaigh círéibeacha sa Pholainn, áit a raibh oibrithe i mbun agóide i gcoinne ganntanas bia agus ciorruithe pá, ina agóid ghinearálta i gcoinne an Chumannachais.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Ach sa deireadh, cé gur chuir Krushchev na tancanna isteach le rudaí a chur in ord, ghéill sé le roinnt éilimh eacnamaíocha agus d'aontaigh sé chun Wladyslaw Gomulka, a raibh gnaoi na ndaoine air, a cheapadh ina phríomh-aire nua.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ba shibhialtacht ón gCré-umhaois í Sibhialtacht Ghleann na hIondúise i bhfo-ilchríoch iarthuaisceart na hIndia a chuimsigh an chuid is mó den Phacastáin sa lá atá inniu ann agus roinnt réigiún in iarthuaisceart na hIndia agus in oirthuaisceart na hAfganastáine.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Rinne an tsibhialtacht go maith in abhantrach na hIondúise agus is as sin a fuair sé a ainm.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Cé go mbíonn tuairimíocht i measc cuid den lucht léinn a mhaíonn toisc gur mhair an tsibhialtacht freisin in abhantracha Abhainn Sarasvati atá triomaithe faoin am seo, ba chóir an t-ainm Sibhialtacht Indus-Sarasvati a thabhairt uirthi dá bharr; tá roinnt léinn ann, áfach, a thugann an tSibhialtacht Harappan uirthi i ndiaidh Harappa, an chéad cheann dá láithreáin a rinneadh tochailt orthu sna 1920idí.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Ba spreagadh é nádúr míleataíoch impireacht na Róimhe chun dul chun cinn a dhéanamh i gcúrsaí míochaine.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Thosaítí ar dhochtúirí a earcú faoin Impire Augustus agus cruthaíodh an chéad Chór Leighis Rómhánach lena úsáid i ndiaidh cathanna.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Bhí eolas ag máinlianna ar thámhachtána éagsúla lena n-áirítear moirfín ó eastóscán síolta poipín agus scopalaimín ó shíolta na gafainne.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Is éard is Neamhord Easnaimh Airde ann ná "siondróm néareolaíoch ar a ndéantar sainmhíniú trína thrí chomhartha chlasaiceacha lena n-áirítear meargántacht, éasca le cur ar seachrán agus hipirghníomhaíocht nó an iomarca fuinnimh."
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Ní míchumas foghlama é, is neamhord foghlama é; "baineann sé d'idir 3 agus 5 faoin gcéad na páistí uile, b'fhéidir suas le 2 mhilliún páiste Meiriceánach".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Téann sé deacair ar leanaí a bhfuil NEA acu a n-aird a dhíriú ar rudaí amhail obair bhaile, ach is féidir leo díriú ar rudaí a mbaineann siad sult as amhail cluichí a imirt nó as a bheith ag breathnú ar na cartúin is fearr leo nó as abairtí gan phoncaíocht a scríobh.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Is dual do na leanaí seo a lán trioblóide a tharraingt orthu féin de bhrí "go nglacann siad páirt in iompraíocht chontúirteach, go mbíonn siad ag troid, agus go gcuireann siad dúshlán faoi dhaoine a bhfuil údarás acu" chun a n-inchinn a spreagadh, de bhrí nach féidir a n-inchinn a spreagadh ar an ngnáthshlí.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Téann ADD i bhfeidhm ar chaidrimh le piaraí eile toisc nach féidir le páistí eile a thuiscint an fáth a ngníomhaíonn siad sa chaoi a ndéantar, nó a litríonn siad sa chaoi a ndéantar, nó go bhfuil leibhéal difriúil aibíochta acu.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Toisc gur tháinig athrú ar an gcumas le teacht ar eolas agus ar an gcumas foghlamtha sa chaoi thuasluaite, d'athraigh an bunráta maidir le heolas a fháil.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Bhí an cur chuige maidir le faisnéis a fháil difriúil. Ní raibh brú níos mó ar an gcuimhne aonair, ach díríodh ina áit sin ar an gcumas téacs a thabhairt chun cuimhne.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Go bunúsach, bhí athrú suntasach le linn na hAthbheochana sa chur chuige i dtaca le foghlaim agus scaipeadh eolais.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Murab ionann agus príomhaigh eile, ní bhaineann homainidí úsáid níos mó as a lámha agus iad ag bogadh nó ag iompar meáchain nó ag luascadh trí na crainn.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Tá lámh agus cos an tsimpeansaí ar aon dul ó thaobh méide agus faid de, rud a léiríonn an úsáid a bhaintear as an lámh chun meáchan a iompar nuair a shiúlann an simpeansaí ar a ailt.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Tá lámh an duine níos giorra ná cos an duine, agus tá na falaing sa lámh níos dírí.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Léirítear le cnámha lámh iontaise atá idir dhá mhilliún agus trí mhilliún bliain d'aois an t-athrú seo a tháinig ar speisialú na láimhe ó ghluaiseacht go láimhseáil.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Tá daoine áirithe a chreideann gur féidir leis a bheith an-tuirsiúil mórchuid brionglóidí soiléire a spreagtar go saorga a bheith ag an duine.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: An phríomhchúis leis an bhfeiniméan seo ná an toradh ar na brionglóidí soiléire a d'fhadaigh an méid ama idir staideanna mearchorraí súl (MCS).
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Gan an oiread mearchorraí súl in aghaidh na hoíche, tagann an staid seo ina bhfaigheann tú codladh iarbhír agus ócáid téarnamh do do chorp chun bheith chomh neamhghnách sin go n-iompaíonn sé ina fhadhb.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Tá sé seo díreach chomh tuirsiúil agus a bheith ag dúiseacht gach fiche nó tríocha nóiméad agus ag féachaint ar an teilifís.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Braitheann an éifeacht ar cé chomh minic is a dhéanann do mheabhair iarracht brionglóid mheabhrach a dhéanamh gach oíche.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Níor éirigh go rómhaith leis na hIodálaigh san Afraic Thuaidh beagnach ón tús. Laistigh de sheachtain ó dhearbhú cogaidh na hIodáile ar an 10 Meitheamh, 1940, ghabh 11ú Hussars na Breataine Fort Capuzzo sa Libia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Ghabh na Briotanaigh an Ginearálta Lastucci, Ard-Innealtóir Deichiú Arm na hIodáile, i luíochán soir ó Bardia.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: A thrúpaí féin a mharaigh an Marascal Italo Balbo, Ard-Ghobharnóir na Libia agus oidhre ​​dealraitheach Mussolini de thaisme, agus é ag teacht i dtír i Tobruk ar an 28 Meitheamh.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Imrítear spórt nua-aimseartha na pionsóireachta ar mórchuid leibhéal, ó mic léinn a fhoghlaimíonn í ar an ollscoil go hiomaitheoirí i gcomórtais ghairmiúla agus Oilimpeacha.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Is cluiche é galf ina n-úsáideann imreoirí maidí le liathróidí a bhualadh isteach i bpoill.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Imrítear ocht bpoll déag le linn gnáthbhabhta, agus go hiondúil tosaíonn na himreoirí ar an gcéad pholl agus críochnaíonn siad ar an ochtú poll déag.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: B’fhéidir gurb é an cineál turasóireachta is coitianta an cineál a shamhlaíonn ár bhformhór leis an taisteal: Turasóireacht áineasa.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Is ionann seo agus nuair a théann daoine chuig áit atá an-difriúil óna saol rialta ó lá go lá chun scíth a ligean agus spraoi a bheith acu.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Is iondúil a bhíonn tránna, páirceanna téama agus láithreacha campála na háiteanna is coitianta ina bhfaightear turasóirí áineasa.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Más é cuspóir na cuairte ort chuig áit ar leith ná aithne a chur ar an stair agus chultúr, tugtar turasóireacht chultúrtha ar an gcineál seo turasóireachta.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Féadfaidh turasóirí cuairt a thabhairt ar áiteanna suntasacha éagsúla i dtír amháin nó díriú ar áit amháin.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Nuair a chonaic na Coilínigh an ghníomhaíocht seo, d'iarr siad trúpaí breise.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Thrasnódh an príomhfhórsa ionsaithe 2,400 fear an abhainn naoi míle ó thuaidh ó Trenton, agus ansin roinnfí ina dhá ghrúpa é, ceann faoi cheannas Greene agus ceann faoi cheannas Sullivan, d’fhonn ionsaí roimh éiri na gréine a sheoladh.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Leis an athrú ón rith ceathrú míle go dtí an rith leath mhíle, maolaíonn tábhacht an luais agus méadaíonn an gá le seasmhacht.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Ní féidir le cleachtais chearta cothaithe ina n-aonar scothfheidhmíocht a ghiniúint, ach is féidir leo tionchar mór a bheith acu ar fholláine iomlán lúthchleasaithe óga.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Is féidir le coinneáil cothromaíocht fuinnimh fholláin, nósanna éifeachta i dtaca le go leor uisce a choinneáil i do chorp agus tuiscint a fháil ar na gnéithe éagsúla de chleachtais bhreisithe a bheith ina chuidiú de lúthchleasaithe a gcuid feidhmíochta a fheabhsú agus níos mó sásaimh a bhaint as an spórt.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Tá rith meánraoin ina spórt measartha saor; tá, áfach, neart míthuiscintí ann i dtaca leis an chúpla píosa trealaimh atá tá de dhíth le páirt a ghlacadh ann.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Éifeachtaí bheith ag súil le tubaistí, ní dúlagar ná eagla, agus é sin amháin a bhraith ar sheisiúin rialta struchtúrtha seachtainiúla le Cúntóir Dochtúra.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Braitheann fís, nó an cumas rudaí a fheiceáil, ar orgáin chéadfacha nó súile céadfacha an chórais amhairc.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Tá mórchuid cineálacha súl ann, ó thaobh déanaimh, agus braitheann a gcastacht ar riachtanais an orgánaigh.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Tá cumais éagsúla ag na tógálacha difriúla, tá siad íogair do thonnfhaid éagsúla agus tá leibhéil éagsúla géire acu, ina theanta sin, teastaíonn próiseáil dhifriúil uathu chun ciall a bhaint as an ionchur agus uimhreacha difriúla chun go n-oibreoidh siad go barrmhaith.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Is éard is daonra ann ná bailiúchán orgánach de speiceas ar leith laistigh de limistéar áirithe geografach.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Nuair a bhíonn tréith feinitíopach ar leith i bpáirt ag gach duine i ndaonra áirithe, tugtar daonra monómorfach orthu.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Nuair a bhíonn athraitheach de thréith ar leith i bpáirt ag daoine, deirtear go bhfuil siad polamorfach.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Déanann coilíneachtaí an tseangáin léigiúnaigh máirseáil agus neadú i gcéimeanna difriúla freisin.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Sa chéim fánaíochta, caitheann seangáil an oíche ag máirseáil, agus stopann siad chun campa a thógáil sa lá.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Cuirtear tús le céim fánaíochta sa choilíneacht tar éis don soláthar bia dul i laghad. Le linn na céime seo, déanann an choilíneacht neadacha sealadacha a athraítear gach lá.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Maireann gach ceann de na babhtaí nó máirseálacha siúlacha seo go ceann thart ar 17 lá.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Cad is cill ann? Ón bhfocal Laidineach "cella", a chiallaíonn "seomra beag", a thagann an focal agus ba é micreascópaí a bhí ag féachaint ar struchtúr coirc a cheap an focal.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Is í an chill aonad bunúsach gach ní bheo, agus tá gach orgánach comhdhéanta de chill amháin nó níos mó.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Bíonn cealla chomh bunúsach agus ríthábhachtach sin sa staidéar ar an mbeatha, ar ndóigh, gur minic a thugtar "na bloicíní lena dtógtar an bheatha" orthu.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Déanann an Córas Néarógach hoiméastáis a choimeád trí néar-ríoga a sheoladh ar fud an choirp chun sreabhadh na fola a choimeád ag imeacht gan chur isteach.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Is féidir na néar-ríoga seo a sheoladh go han-tapa ar fud an choirp, rud a chabhraíonn leis an gcorp a choinneáil slán ó aon bhagairt fhéideartha.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Limistéar beag is ea a bhuaileann tornádó, i gcomparáid le stoirmeacha foréigneacha eile, ach is féidir leo gach rud atá sa tslí orthu a scriosadh.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Scriosann tornádónna crainn, sracann siad cláir as foirgnimh, agus caitheann siad cairr suas sa spéir. Maireann an dá faoin gcéad is foréigní de thornádónna níos mó ná trí huaire an chloig.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Bíonn luas suas go 480 km/u (133 m/s; 300 msu ag na gaotha sna hollstoirmeacha seo.
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Tá daoine ag déanamh agus ag úsáid lionsaí le haghaidh formhéadúcháin leis na mílte, mílte bliain.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Mar sin féin, rinneadh na chéad fhíor-theileascóip san Eoraip ag deireadh an 16ú haois.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: D'úsáid na teileascóip seo comhcheangal de dhá lionsa chun go mbeadh an chuma ar rudaí atá i bhfad uainn go raibh siad níos gaire agus níos mó.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Beidh an tsaint agus an leithleachas linn go deo agus is é nádúr an chomhoibrithe é nuair a bhíonn buntáiste ag an móramh, go mbeidh i gcónaí tuilleadh le fáil sa ghearrthéarma trí ghníomhú go leithleach.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Le cúnamh Dé tabharfaidh an chuid is mó de dhaoine faoi deara gurb é an rogha is fearr ná a bheith ag obair le chéile.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Tá aisling ag neart daoine faoin lá ar féidir le daoine taisteal chuig réalta eile agus taiscéalaíocht a dhéanamh ar dhomhain eile, tá iad a bhíonn ag machnamh faoina bhfuil amuigh ansin, tá iad a chreideann go bhféadfadh eachtráin nó beatha eile a bheith ann ar phláinéad eile.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ach dá dtarlódh sé sin riamh, ní dócha go dtarlódh sé go ceann i bhfad Éireann amach uainn. Tá na réaltaí chomh scaipthe amach óna chéile go mbíonn na trilliúin míle idir réaltaí ar "chomharsana" iad.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Lá éigin d'fhéadfadh do gharpháistí a bheith ag seasamh ar dhomhan eachtráin ag machnamh ar a sinsir a mhair fadó?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Tá ainmhithe déanta de go leor cealla. Itheann siad rudaí agus déantar é sin a dhíleá istigh sa chorp. Bíonn an chuid is mó d'ainmhithe in ann gluaiseacht.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Ag ainmhithe amháin atá inchinn (cé nach amhlaidh i gcás gach ainmhí; ní aon inchinn sa smugairle róin, mar shampla).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Feicimid ainmhithe ar fud an domhain. Bíonn siad ag tochailt sa talamh, ag snámh sna haigéin, agus ag eitilt sa spéir.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: An t-aonad struchtúrach agus feidhmiúil is lú de chuid orgánach (nithe) beo is ea cealla.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Tagann an focal cill ón bhfocal Laidin cella a chiallaíonn seomra beag.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Má bhreathnaíonn tú ar nithe beo faoi mhicreascóp, feicfidh tú gur as cearnóga nó liathróidí beaga atá siad déanta.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: D'úsáid Robert Hooke, bitheolaí ó Shasana, micreascóp chun cearnóga a fheiceáil i gcorc.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Bhí cuma seomraí orthu. Ba é an chéad duine é a d'fhéach ar chealla marbha.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Is féidir le heilimintí agus comhdhúile bogadh ó staid amháin go staid eile agus gan aon athrú teacht orthu.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Tá na hairíonna céanna ag nítrigin mar ghás agus leacht. Tá an stát leachtach níos dlúithe ach tá na móilíní fós mar an gcéanna.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Is sampla eile é an t-uisce. Tá comhdhúil an uisce comhdhéanta de dhá adamh hidrigine agus adamh ocsaigine amháin.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Tá an struchtúr móilíneach céanna aige cibé an gás, leacht nó solad é.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Cé gur féidir athrú teacht ar a staid fisiciúil, fanann a staid ceimiceach mar atá sé.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Dlúthchuid den saol is ea an t-am, agus tá tionchar aige ar an uile rud a dhéanaimid, ach fós féin tá sé deacair a thuiscint.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Tá staidéar déanta ar an am ar scoláirí reiligiúnacha, fealsúnachta agus eolaíochta leis na mílte bliain.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Braithimid an t-am mar shraith imeachtaí ag dul ón todhchaí go dtí an lá inniu go dtí an t-am atá thart.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Úsáidtear am, leis, chun tréimhsí imeachtaí a chur i gcomparáid.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Féadfaidh tú caitheamh na haimsire a mharcáil tú féin trí fhéachaint ar imeacht timthriallach á áthdhéanamh. Imeacht timthriallach is ea rud a tharlaíonn arís agus arís go rialta.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Úsáidtear ríomhairí inniu le pictiúir agus físeáin a ionramháil.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Is féidir beochana sofaisticiúla a thógáil ar ríomhairí, agus tá an cineál seo beochana ag éirí níos coitianta i gcónaí i gcláir theilifíse agus i scannáin.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Is minic a dhéantar ceol a thaifeadadh le ríomhairí sofaisticiúla chun na fuaimeanna a phróiseáil agus a mheascadh le chéile.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Ar feadh tamall fada le linn an naoú haois déag agus an fichiú haois, tuigeadh go raibh an pobal Maori ina chéad áitritheoirí sa Nua Shéalainn, agus go mbíodh siad ag seilg éin ollmhóra dá dtugtar moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Ansin bhunaigh an teoiric an smaoineamh gur imigh muintir na Maori ón bPolainéis i gcabhlach mór agus gur ghabh siad an Nua-Shéalainn ó na Moriori, ag bunú sochaí talmhaíochta.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Tugann fianaise nua le tuiscint, áfach, gur dream Maorach ón mórthír a bhí sna Moriori a d'aistrigh ón Nua-Shéalainn go dtí na hOileáin Chatham, agus a d'fhorbair a gcultúr sainiúil síochánta féin.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Bhí treibh eile ar oileáin Chatham freisin, ba iad seo na Maori a chuaigh ar imirce ón Nua-Shéalainn.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Na Moriori a thugann siad orthu féin; bhí cúpla gráscar ann agus ar deireadh díothaíodh na Moriori.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Chuidigh daoine aonair a bhí bainteach le blianta fada linn meas a bheith againn ar ár láidreachtaí agus paisin fad a bhí muid ag déanamh measúnú ar dheacrachtaí agus fiú teipeanna.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Agus muid ag éisteacht le daoine ag insint scéalta fúthu féin, faoina dteaghlach nó faoina n-eagraíocht, fuaireamar léargas fiúntach ar an am atá caite agus ar chuid de na daoine a raibh dea-thionchar nó droch-thionchar acu ar chultúr na heagraíochta.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Cé nach samhlaítear tuiscint ar an gcultúr le tuiscint ar an stair, cabhraíonn sé ar a laghad le daoine tuiscint a fháil ar an áit atá acu laistigh de stair na heagraíochta.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Agus éachtaí á meas agus dul i bhfeasacht ar theipeanna, tagann daoine aonair agus gach duine atá rannpháirteach ar thuiscint níos doimhne ar luachanna, misean agus fórsaí tiomána na heagraíochta.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Sa chás seo, trí chuimhneach siar ar chásanna roimhe seo ar iompar fiontraíochta agus an rath a tharla dá bharr, chabhraigh sé le daoine a bheith oscailte d’athruithe nua agus treo nua don eaglais áitiúil.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Laghdaigh scéalta rathúla den sórt sin an eagla roimh athrú, agus cruthaíodh claontaí dearfacha i leith athruithe sa todhchaí.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Is éard atá i gceist le patrúin na smaointeoireachta aontreoiche ná teicnící réitithe fadhbanna a thugann smaointe nó réimsí difriúla le chéile chun teacht ar réiteach.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Is dual do dhaoine a bhfuil an cineál seo meoin acu díriú ar luas, loighic agus cruinneas, agus ar fhíricí a aithint, teicnící atá ann cheana a athúsáid, agus faisnéis a bhailiú.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Is é an fachtóir is tábhachtaí den mheon seo: níl ach freagra ceart amháin ann. Ní smaoiníonn tú ach ar dhá fhreagra, is é sin ceart nó mícheart.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Le nósanna imeachta áirithe eolaíochta nó buan-nósanna imeachta a shamhlaítear an cineál seo smaointeoireachta.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Daoine a smaoiníonn ar an tslí seo, deirtear go bhfuil siad loighciúil, agus bíonn ar a gcumas patrúin a chur de ghlanmheabhair, fadhbanna a fhuascailt agus turgnaimh eolaíochta a dhéanamh.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Is é an duine an speiceas is cumasaí ó thaobh intinn duine eile a léamh.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Ciallaíonn sé sin gur féidir linn an rud a bhraitheann daoine eile, atá ar intinn acu, a chreideann siad, a bhfuil ar eolas acu nó is mian dóibh a thuar go cinnte.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: I measc na gcumas sin, is rud ríthábhachtach é tuiscint a bheith agat ar rún an duine eile. Cuireann sé sin ar ár gcumas réiteach a fháil ar na débhríonna féideartha a bhaineann le gníomhartha fisiciúla.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Mar shampla, dá bhfeicfeá duine i mbun fuinneog cairr a bhriseadh, is dócha go mheasfá gur carr le strainséir a bhí sé ag iarraidh a ghoid.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Dhéanfaí breithiúnas difriúil air dá mbeadh a chuid eochracha cairr caillte aige agus dá mbeadh air briseadh isteach ina charr féin.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Tá MRI bunaithe ar feiniméan fisice ar a thugtar athshondas maighnéadach núicléach (NMR) a tháinig Felix Bloc (agus é ag obair in Ollscoil Stanford) agus Edward Purcell (ó Ollscoil Harvard) air sna 1930idí.
