text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: San athshondas seo, cuireann réimse maighnéadacha agus tonnta raidió na hadaimh ag tabhairt comharthaí raidió bídeacha.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Sa bhliain 1970, d'aimsigh Raymond Damadian, dochtúir leighis agus eolaí taighde, an bonn chun íomháú athshondais mhaighnéadach a úsáid mar uirlis le haghaidh diagnóis leighis.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Ceithre bliana níos déanaí, ceadaíodh paitinn ina leith, arb í sin an chéad phaitinn ar domhan a eisíodh i réimse an ÍAM.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: D'éirigh leis an Dr. Damadian an chéad scanóir MRI “lánchorp” a chríochnú i 1977, an “Indomitable” a bhaist sé air.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Leis an gcumarsáid aisioncronach tugtar am le machnamh a dhéanamh agus le freagairt ar dhaoine eile.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Tugtar deis do mhic léinn a bheith ag obair ar a luas féin agus luas na faisnéise teagaisc a rialú.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ina theannta sin, tá níos lú srianta ama ann agus tá an deis ann uaireanta oibre solúbtha a bheith ann. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Cuireann an tIdirlíon agus an Gréasán Domhanda ar chumas d'fhoghlaimeoirí teacht a bheith acu de shíor ar fhaisnéis.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Is féidir le mic léinn ceisteanna a chur isteach chuig teagascóirí uair ar bith den lá agus bheith ag súil le freagra réasúnta gasta, seachas fanacht ar an gcéad chruinniú duine le duine eile.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Tugann an cur chuige iar-nua-aoiseach i leith na foghlama saoirse ó absalóidí. Níl aon bhealach maith amháin chun foghlaim a dhéanamh.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: I ndáiríre níl oiread is rud amháin fiúntach le foghlaim. Tarlaíonn foghlaim sa chaidreamh idir an foghlaimeoir agus an t-eolas a chuirtear i láthair.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Is léiriú ar an bpointe seo é ár dtaithí na laethanta seo ar mhórchuid seónna teilifíse déan féin é, faisnéise, agus foghlama.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Tarlaíonn sé go bhféachann líon mór dínn ar sheó teilifíse a chuireann ar an eolas muid faoi phróiseas nó eispéireas nach nglacfaimid páirt ann riamh nó nach gcuirfimid an t-eolas sin i bhfeidhm.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Go deo, ní dhéanfaimid carr a ollchóiriú, tobair a thógáil inár ngairdín cúil, taisteal go Peiriú chun fothracha ársa a scrúdú, nó teach ár gcomharsan a athmhúnlú.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: A bhuíochas ar naisc cábla snáthoptaice chuig an Eoraip agus satailít leathanbhanda, tá ceangal maith ag an nGraonlainn le 93% den daonra a bhfuil rochtain idirlín acu.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Is dócha go mbeidh wifi nó ríomhaire ceangailte leis an idirlíon ag d’óstán nó ag d’óstaigh (má tá tú ag fanacht i dteach aíochta nó i dteach príobháideach), agus bíonn caife idirlín nó áit éigin le wifi poiblí ag gach lonnaíocht.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Mar atá thuasluaite, ainneoin go bhfuil an focal "Eiscimeach" fós inghlactha i Stáit Aontaithe Mheiriceá, meastar gur focal maslach é i measc go leor ciníocha an Artaigh nach Meiriceánaigh iad, go háirithe i gCeanada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Cé gur féidir go gcloisfidh tú an focal ó Dhúchasaigh na Graonlainne, níor cheart d'eachtrannaigh é a úsáid.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Ionúitigh a thugann áitritheoirí dúchasacha na Graonlainne orthu féin i gCeanada agus Kalaalleq (Kalaallit an t-iolra), a chiallaíonn duine ón nGraonlainn, sa Ghraonlainn.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Is ar éigean a fhaightear coireacht, agus drochrún do strainséirí go ginearálta, sa Ghraonlainn. Fiú amháin sna bailte, ní bhíonn aon "cheantair gharbha" iontu.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: B'fhéidir gurb í an aimsir fhuar an t-aon fhíor-dainséar, a gcaithfeadh an duine neamhullmhaithe dul i ngleic leis.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Má thugann tú cuairt ar an nGraonlainn sna séasúir fhuara (cuir san áireamh gurb is faide ó thuaidh a théann tú, níos fuaire a bheidh sé), tá sé riachtanach éadaí atá te go leor a thabhairt leat.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Is féidir leis na laethanta an-fhada sa samhradh a bheith ina gcúis le fadhbanna ó thaobh dóthain codlata a fháil agus fadbhanna sláinte a ghabhann leis sin.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Le linn an tsamhraidh, bí ag faire amach do mhuiscítí Nordacha freisin. Cé nach scaipeann siad aon ghalair, is féidir leo a bheith bearránach.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Cé go bhfuil geilleagar San Francisco nasctha lena stádas mar tharraingt den scoth do thurasóirí, tá geilleagar éagsúlaithe aige.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Is iad na hearnálacha fostaíochta is mó seirbhísí gairmiúla, rialtas, airgeadas, trádáil, agus turasóireacht.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Tá cáil ar an gcathair agus ar a chomharthaí críche ar fud an domhain, go mór mór de bhrí go ndéantar tagairt dó go rialta sa cheol, i scannáin, sa litríocht agus i cultúr na ndaoine.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Gheofar bonneagar mór turasóireachta in San Francisco -- mórchuid óstán, bialann agus saoráidí comhdhála den scoth.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Tá San Francisco ar cheann de na háiteanna is fearr sa tír chun cócaireacht Áiseach eile a bhlaiseadh: cócaireacht Chóiréach, Téalannach, Indiach, agus Seapánach.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Is oilithreacht mhór é do mhórchuid teaghlach Meiriceánach dul ag triall ar Walt Disney World.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Is éard is "gnáth"-chuairt ann eitilt isteach in Aerfort Idirnáisiúnta Orlando, dul ar bhus go hóstán Disney ar an láthair, seachtain nó mar sin a chaitheamh gan réadmhaoin Disney a fhágáil, agus filleadh abhaile.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Níl teora leis na héagsúlachtaí, ach seo an rud a bhíonn i gceist ag formhór na ndaoine nuair a labhraíonn siad faoi "dhul go Disney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Is ticéid il-lá páirce atá úsáidte cheana féin iad chuid mhaith de na ticéid a dhíoltar ar líne trí shuíomhanna ceantála ar nós eBay nó Craigslist.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Cé gur gníomhaíocht an-choitianta é seo, tá sé coiscthe ag Disney: níl na ticéid inaistrithe.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Tá cead cúlráide de dhíth chun campáil ar bith a dhéanamh faoi bhun an imill in Grand Canyon.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Tá teorainn le líon na gceadanna a eisítear, chun an cainneon a chosaint, agus cuirtear ar fáil iad ar an 1ú lá den mhí, ceithre mhí roimh an mhí thosaigh.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Mar sin, tagann cead cúltíre d’aon dáta tosaigh i mí na Bealtaine chun bheith ar fáil ar an 1 Eanáir.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Is gnách don spás do na háiteanna is mó tóir, amhail Láthair Champála an Aingil Ghil láimhe leis an Phantom Ranch, líonadh suas as na hiarratais a fhaightear ar an gcéad lá a n-osclaítear iad d'áirithintí.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Coinnítear líon teoranta ceadanna d'iarratais siúl isteach agus tá siad ar fáil ar bhonn tiocfaidh do sheal mar a thiocfaidh tú féin.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Is bealach iontach é le háilleacht uile an réigiúin a fheiceáil má thagann tú isteach chuig an Afraic-Theas i gcarr, agus is maith é sin freisin chun dul go háiteanna nach mbaineann le gnáth-bhealaí turasóireachta.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Is féidir é seo a dhéanamh i ngnáthcharr le pleanáil chúramach ach moltar go mór 4x4 a úsáid agus tá go leor áiteanna nach bhfuil insroichte ach amháin le bonn rotha ard 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Cuimhnigh agus tú i mbun pleanála cé go bhfuil an Afraic Theas socair ní shin mar atá na tíortha ar fad thart air.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Athraíonn riachtanais agus costais víosa ó náisiún go náisiún agus braitheann siad ar an tír arb as duit.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Bíonn dlíthe ar leith ag gach aon tír freisin lena n-éilítear na míreanna éigeandála nach foláir a bheith sa charr.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Is baile sa chuid thiar den tSiombáib é Victoria Falls, trasna na teorann ó Livingstone, an tSaimbia, agus gar don Bhotsuáin.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Díreach taobh leis an eas atá an baile suite, agus is mór an tarraingt iad, ach gheobhaidh daoine atá ar thóir na heachtraíochta agus turasóirí araon neart deiseanna chun cuairt fhada a thabhairt ar an gceann scríbe cáiliúil turasóireachta seo.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Le linn séasúr na báistí (Samhain go Márta), beidh an toirt uisce níos airde agus beidh na hEasanna níos drámatúil.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Gealltar go bhfliuchfar thú má thrasnaíonn tú an droichead nó má shiúlann tú feadh na gcosán lúbach gar don Eas.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Ar an láimh eile, is é méid an uisce a bheith chomh mór sin a chuirfidh bac ar do radharc ar an Eas féin—an t-uisce go léir is cúis leis!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Tuama Thútancáman (KV62). Is féidir gurb é KV62 an tuama is mó cáil as na tuamaí sa Ghleann, an áit a dtáinig Howard Carter ar adhlacadh ríoga beagnach slán an rí óig i 1922.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: I gcomparáid le formhór na dtuama ríoga eile, áfach, is ar éigean is fiú cuairt a thabhairt ar thuama Tutankhamun, agus é i bhfad níos lú agus ar bheagán maisiúcháin.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Duine ar bith ar mian leis/léi breathnú ar rian an damáiste a rinneadh don mumaí le linn iarrachtaí ar a bhaint ón gcónra, ní bheifear in ann é sin a shásamh, mar níl ach an cloigeann agus na guaillí infheicthe.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Níl an saibhreas ollmhór a bhí sa tuama ann níos mó, tugadh ar shiúl é chuig an Músaem Éigipteach in Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: B'fhearr do chuairteoirí nach bhfuil mórán ama acu an t-am sin a chaitheamh in áit éigin eile.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km siar ó dheas ó Siem Reap. Ag deireadh an 9ú haois, le linn réimeas an Rí Yasovarman, a tógadh an teampall seo ar bharr cnoic.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Is fiú go mór dreapadh suas an cnoc chun iontas a dhéanamh d'atmaisféar gruama an teampaill agus den radharc thar loch Tonle Sap.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Is féidir cuairt ar an suíomh a cheangal go háisiúil le turas báid go dtí an loch.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Is gá Pas Angkor chun dul isteach sa teampall mar sin ná dearmad do phas a thabhairt leat nuair a dhéanann tú ar Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Is é Iarúsailéim an phríomhchathair agus an chathair is mó san Iosrael cé nach n-aithníonn formhór tíortha agus na Náisiúin Aontaithe é mar phríomhchathair Iosrael.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Tá stair fíorshuimiúil ag an gcathair ársa i gcnoic Iúidáis, stair a théann siar na mílte bliain.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Is cathair naofa í i sna trí reiligiún aondiachúla - an Giúdachas, an Chríostaíocht agus Ioslam - agus feidhmíonn sí mar ionad spioradálta, reiligiúnach agus cultúrtha.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: De bharr thábhacht reiligiúnach na gcathrach, go háirithe an iliomad suíomhanna sin thart ar an tSean-Chathair, tá Iarúsailéim ar cheann de na príomháiteanna do thurasóirí in Iosrael.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Tá roinnt láithreacha stairiúla, seandálaíochta agus cultúrtha ag Iarúsailéim mar aon le hionaid siopadóireachta, caiféanna agus bialanna.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Éilíonn Eacuadór ar shaoránaigh Chúba go bhfaighidh siad litir chuiridh sula dtagann siad isteach go hEacuadór trí aerfoirt idirnáisiúnta nó ag pointí iontrála na teorann.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Caithfidh Aireacht Gnóthaí Eachtracha Eacuadór an litir seo a dhéanamh dleathach, agus ceanglais áirithe a chomhlíonadh.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Tá na riachtanais seo ceaptha le sreabhadh eagraithe imirce a sholáthar idir an dá thír.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Ba chóir do shaoránaigh Cúbacha, ar sealbhóirí chárta glas na Stát Aontaithe iad, cuairt a thabhairt ar Chonsalacht an Eacuadór le díolúine ón riachtanas seo a fháil.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Caithfidh do phas a bheith bailí ar feadh 6 mhí ar a laghad tar éis do dhátaí taistil. Is gá ticéad do thuras fillte/thuras ar aghaidh chun fad do chuairte a chruthú.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Dá mhéad daoine atá sa ghrúpa, is ea is saoire an turas, mar sin má tá tú i d'aonar nó le cara amháin, déan iarracht grúpa ceathrair nó seisir a dhéanamh le daoine eile chun ráta níos fearr in aghaidh an duine a fháil.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Mar sin féin, níor cheart go mbaineann sé seo leatsa i ndáiríre, mar is minic go mbíonn turasóirí á bhogadh timpeall chun na carranna a líonadh.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Is cosúil gur chleas é le tabhairt le fios do dhaoine go gcaithfidh siad níos mó a íoc.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Síneann an sliabh géar seo go spéir os cionn ceann thuaidh Machu Picchu, agus is minic a fheictear é mar chúlra i ngrianghraif de na fothracha.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Tá cuma scanrúil ón áit thíos agus is dreapadh crochta agus deacair é ach ba chóir go mbeidh daoine atá réasúnta aclaí in ann é a dhéanamh i thart 45 nóiméad.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Tá céimeanna cloiche leagtha síos feadh an chuid is mó den chosán agus sna codanna is crochta feidhmíonn cáblaí cruach mar ráille láimhe tacaíochta.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: É sin ráite, bí ag súil le gearranáil, agus bí cúramach sna codanna is crochta, go háirithe nuair a bhíonn siad fliuch, de bhrí gur féidir le contúirt teacht chun cinn go gasta.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Tá pluais bhídeach gar don bharr a gcaithfear gabháil tríd, tá sé íseal go leor agus teann.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Is fearr féachaint ar láithreáin agus fiadhúlra Oileáin Galápagos ó bhád, díreach mar a rinne Charles Darwin i 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Seolann níos mó ná 60 long chrúsála trí uiscí Galapagos - agus slí iontu do idir ochtar agus 100 paisinéir.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Déanann formhór na ndaoine áit a chur in áirithint i bhfad roimh ré (toisc go mbíonn na báid lán go hiondúil in ard an tséasúir).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Déan cinnte de go mbeidh an gníomhaire trína gcuirfidh tú áirithint ina shaineolaí ar Oileáin Galápagos, agus eolas maith aige ar réimse leathan de longa.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Cinnteoidh sé seo go ndéanfar d'ábhair spéise agus/nó do shrianta ar leith a mheaitseáil leis an long is oiriúnaí dóibh.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Sular tháinig na Spáinnigh sa 16ú haois, bhíodh tuaisceart na Sile faoi riail na nIncach agus bhíodh na hArócánaigh (Mapuche) áitrithe sa tSile láir agus i ndeisceart na Sile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Bhí an Mapuche ar cheann de na grúpaí dúchasacha neamhspleácha Meiriceánacha deireanacha, nár slogadh isteach i riail na gcainteoirí Spáinnise go dtí tar éis don tSile a saoirse a bhaint amach.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Cé gur fhógair an tSile a neamhspleáchas in 1810 (i lár Chogaí Napoléon lena bhfágadh an Spáinn gan rialtas lárnach i bhfeidhm go ceann cúpla bliain), níor baineadh amach an bua cinniúnach ar na Spáinnigh go dtí 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Is tír sa Mhuir Chairib í an Phoblacht Dhoiminiceach (Spáinnis: República Dominicana), a chlúdaíonn an leath thoir d’oileán Hispaniola, a roinneann sí le Háití.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Gan trácht ar na tránna bána agus tírdhreacha sléibhe, is sa tír seo a bunaíodh an chathair Eorpach is sine atá i gCríocha Mheiriceá, agus í ina cuid de Santo Domingo anois.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Ba iad na Taínos agus na Caribes na chéad daoine a chuir fúthu ar an oileán. Arawakan is ea a labhair na Caribes agus ba timpeall 10,000 R.Ch. a tháinig siad go dtí an t-oileán.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Laistigh de chúpla bliain ghearr tar éis do thaiscéalaithe Eorpacha an tír a shroicheadh, bhí daonra Tainos laghdaithe go mór ag concairí na Spáinne.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Bunaithe ar chuntas Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) mharaigh gabhálaithe na Spáinne thart ar 100,000 Taínos idir 1492 agus 1498.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Tógadh an spás seo mar aitriam do chlochar 17ú haois agus is é an Templo de San Diego an t-aon fhoirgneamh acu atá fós ann.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Anois feidhmíonn sé mar an plás lárnach agus bíonn neart rudaí ag dul ar aghaidh, lá agus oíche.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Tá roinnt bialann timpeall an ghairdín, agus san iarnóin agus sa tráthnóna is minic a thugtar ceolchoirmeacha saor in aisce ón gazebo lárnach.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Lána na Póige). Dhá bhalcóin nach bhfuil ach 69 ceintiméadar eatarthu is ea an áit taobh thiar de sheanscéal grá.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Inseoidh cuid leanaí scéal duit má íocann tú cúpla pingin as.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Turas lae nó turas deireadh seachtaine a bhfuil an-éileamh air is ea Oileán Bowen a mbíonn cadhcáil, siúlóireacht, siopaí, bialanna agus tuilleadh ar fáil ann.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Tá an pobal barántúil seo lonnaithe i Howe Sound díreach amach ó Vancouver, agus is furasta iad a shroicheadh i dtacsaithe sceidealta uisce a fhágann ó Oileán Granville i lár Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Dóibh siúd a bhaineann sult as gníomhaíochtaí lasmuigh, caithfidh siad fálróid suas chonaire Farraige go Spéir a dhéanamh.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Tá Whistler (1.5 uair an chloig de thuras cairr ó Vancouver) daor ach tá cáil air mar gheall ar Chluichí Oilimpeacha an Gheimhridh 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Sa gheimhreadh, bain taitneamh as cuid de na sciáil is fearr i Meiriceá Thuaidh, agus i rith an tsamhraidh bain triail as rothaíocht sléibhe barántúil.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Caithfear ceadanna a chur in áirithe roimh ré. Caithfidh cead a bheith agat chun an oíche a chaitheamh ag Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Is é Sirena an t-aon stáisiún maoirseora a thairgeann lóistín suanliosanna agus béilí te i dteannta le campáil. Ní thairgeann La Leona, San Pedrillo, agus Los Patos ach campáil gan aon seirbhís bia.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Is féidir cead páirce a fháil díreach ó Stáisiún an Mhaoir i Puerto Jiménez ach ní ghlacann siad le cártaí creidmheasa.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Ní eisíonn an tSeirbhís Páirceanna (MINAE) ceadanna páirce níos mó ná mí sula mbíonn súil leis na cuairteoirí.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Cuireann CafeNet El Sol seirbhís áirithinte ar fáil ar phraghas US$30, nó $10 le haghaidh pas lae; gheobhaidh tú mionsonraí ar a leathanach Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Is tír oileáin iad na hOileáin Cook a bhfuil stádas saorchomhlachais acu leis an Nua-Shéalainn, tá siad suite sa Pholainéis, i lár an Aigéin Chiúin Theas.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Is oileánra é le 15 oileán scaipthe amach thar 2.2 milliún km2 d'fharraige.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Tá Haváí sa chrios ama céanna leis na hoileáin, mar sin tugtar "Haváí na hAstráile" ar na hoileáin uaireanta.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Tá siad níos lú, ach meabhraíonn sé do chuairteoirí scothaosta Haváí sula ndearnadh stát de, gan na hóstáin mhóra turasóireachta agus an fhorbairt eile go léir.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Cúig oileán déag atá i gceist in Oileáin Cook gan aon chathair. Is iad Rarotonga agus Aitutaki na príomh-oileáin.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: I dtíortha forbartha inniu, rinneadh cineál ealaíne as leaba agus bricfeasta sómasach a chur ar fáil.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ag barr an mhargaidh, ar ndóigh bíonn B&Banna san iomaíocht ar dhá phríomhrud: cóir leapa agus bricfeasta.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Dá réir sin, d'fhéadfá an chóir leapa is sóúla a fháil, amhail cuilt déanta de láimh nó leaba sheanda, ag scoth na ngnólachtaí den sórt sin.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Le haghaidh bricfeasta is féidir go bhfaighidh tú bia blasta séasúrach an réigiúin, nó mias speisialta an óstaigh.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: D’fhéadfadh gur seanfhoirgneamh stairiúil é an suíomh le fearas ársa, tailte an-néata agus linn snámha.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Is é an rud simplí a bhaineann le do charr féin a thógáil agus imeacht ar thuras fada bóthair a dhéanann sé tarraingteach ann féin é.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Murab ionann agus feithiclí móra, seans go bhfuil taithí agat cheana féin ar do charr a thiomáint agus gurb eol duit na teorainneacha atá i gceist leis.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Is féidir aird nach bhfuil de dhíth a tharraingt go héasca má chuirtear puball in airde ar réadmhaoin phríobháideach nó i mbaile de mhéid ar bith.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: I mbeagán focal, is bealach iontach é turas bóthair a dhéanamh agus do charr in úsáid agat ach is annamh féin gur bealach é "campa" a dhéanamh.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Is féidir campáil chairr a dhéanamh má tá mionveain mhór, SUV, Carr Salúin nó Carr Fada agat lenar féidir na suíocháin a luí siar.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Tá roinnt óstán ann a bhfuil oidhreacht acu ó ré órga na n-iarnród gaile agus na línéar aigéin; roimh an Dara Cogadh Domhanda, sa 19ú haois nó i dtús an 20ú haois.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Ba sna hóstáin seo a d'fhanadh daoine saibhre agus mór le rá an uair sin, agus is minic a bhíodh mórdhinnéir agus siamsaíocht oíche acu.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Is cuid dá gcarachtar iad, leis, na feistis sean-aimseartha, na taitneamhachtaí is déanaí a bheith in easnamh, agus scothaostacht ghrástúil áirithe.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Cé gur úinéirí príobháideacha atá i gceist lena bhformhór, ó am go chéile is ann a fhanann ceannairí stáit atá ar cuairt agus daoine eile mór le rá.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Taistealaí atá an-saibhir, féadfaidh sé/sí smaoineamh ar eitilt a théann timpeall an domhain, trínar féidir an turas a bhriseadh le cuairteanna ar roinnt mhaith de na hóstáin seo.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Is éard is gréasán malartaithe aíochta ann ná an eagraíocht a cheanglaíonn taistealaithe le daoine áitiúla sna cathracha a dtugann siad cuairt orthu.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Le ceangal le líonra den chineál seo, go hiondúil ní bhíonn ort ach foirm a líonadh ar líne; cé go mbíonn líonraí áirithe ag tairiscint nó ag lorg fíoraithe breise.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Ansin tugtar liosta priontáilte agus/nó ar líne de na hóstaigh atá ar fáil, i dteannta moltaí agus léirmheasanna ó thaistealaithe eile uaireanta.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Cuireadh tolgshurfáil ar bun in Eanáir 2004 tar éis don ríomhchláraitheoir Casey Fenton eitilt shaor go dtí an Íoslainn a fháil ach nach raibh áit aige le fanacht ann.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Sheol sé ríomhphoist chuig mic léinn in ollscoil áitiúil agus fuair sé líon ollmhór tairiscintí maidir le lóistín saor in aisce.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Bíonn brúnna ag freastal ar dhaoine óga go príomha - bíonn an gnáth-aoi sna fichidí - cé go bhfeictear taistealaithe níos sine ann freisin.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Is annamh a fheictear teaghlaigh agus leanaí in éineacht leo, ach tá roinnt brúnna ann a cheadaíonn sin le seomraí príobháideacha.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Is í cathair Bhéising sa tSín a óstálfaidh na Cluichí Oilimpeacha Geimhridh in 2022, a fhágann go mbeidh sí ar an gcéad chathair a d'óstáil na Cluichí Oilimpeacha samhraidh agus geimhridh.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Déanfaidh Béising óstáil ar na searmanais don oscailt agus don chlabhsúr chomh maith leis na himeachtaí oighir faoi dhíon.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Reáchtálfar imeachtaí sciála eile ag ionad sciála Taizicheng i Zhangjiakou, thart ar 220 km (140 míle) ó Bhéising.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Tá féile bhliantúil ag cuid is mó de na teampaill ag tosú ó dheireadh mhí na Samhna chuig lár mhí Bhealtaine, a athraíonn de réir féilire bliantúil gach teampall.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Tá mórchuid de na féilte teampaill ceiliúrtha mar chuid de chomóradh an teampaill nó breithlá na ndéithe atá i réim nó aon mhórimeacht eile bainteach leis an teampall.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Tá féilte na dteampall i Kerala thar a bheith spéisiúil le feiceáil, le scuaine rialta d'eilifintí maisithe, ceolfhoireann teampaill agus imeachtaí ceiliúrtha eile.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Is é is Aonach Domhanda ann (ar a dtugtar go minic Mórthaispeántas Domhanda, nó i bhfocal simplí Móraonach) ná féile mhór idirnáisiúnta na n-ealaíon agus na n-eolaíochtaí.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Cuireann tíortha rannpháirteacha taispeántais ealaíne agus oideachais i láthair i bpailliúin náisiúnta chun saincheisteanna domhanda nó cultúr agus stair a dtíre féin a thaispeáint.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Is imeachtaí speisialaithe iad Taispeántais Gairneoireachta Idirnáisiúnta a thaispeánann taispeántais bláthanna, gairdíní luibheolaíocha agus aon rud eile a bhaineann le plandaí.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Cé go teoiriciúil is féidir iad a reáchtáladh ar bhonn bliantúil (fad is a bhíonn siad i dtíortha éagsúla), go praiticiúil ní tharlaíonn sin.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Is gnách go maireann na himeachtaí seo idir trí agus sé mhí, agus tionóltar iad ar láithreáin a bhfuil achar 50 heicteár ar a laghad iontu.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Is iomaí formáid scannáin a úsáideadh thar na blianta. Is é scannán caighdeánach 35 mm (claonchló 36 faoi 24 mm) an ceann is coitianta.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: De ghnáth is féidir é a athlíonadh go measartha éasca má ritheann sé amach ort agus tugann sé taifeach atá nach mór mar an gcéanna le DSLR reatha.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Úsáideann roinnt ceamaraí meánfhormáide formáid 6 faoi 6 cm, nó claonchló 56 faoi 56 mm, le bheith níos cruinne.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Tugann sé seo taifeach atá beagnach ceithre oiread taifeach claonchló 35 mm (3136 mm2 i gcomparáid le 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Tá an fiadhúlra i measc na móitífeanna is dúshlánaí don ghrianghrafadóir, agus is gá meascán d'ádh, d'fhoighne, de thaithí agus de threalamh maith chuige.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Ní minic a thugtar suntas don ghrianghrafadóireacht fiadhúlra, ach mar is fíor i gcás na grianghrafadóireachta i gcoitinne, is fiú míle focal pictiúr.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Is minic a bhíonn lionsa fada teileafóta de dhíth don ghrianghrafadóireacht fiadhúlra, cé go dteastaíonn lionsaí eile fós do rudaí cosúil le healta éan nó créatúir bhídeacha.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Tá sé deacair neart ainmhithe neamhchoitianta a aimsiú agus in amanna tá rialacha ag páirceanna i dtaobh grianghraif a ghlacadh dóibh chun críocha tráchtála.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Is féidir le hainmhithe fiáine a bheith cúthail nó ionsaitheach. Is féidir leis an timpeallacht a bheith fuar, te, nó naimhdeach ar shlí eile.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Tá os cionn 5,000 teanga ar domhan, lena n-áirítear os cionn fiche atá á labhairt ag 50 milliún cainteoir nó os a chionn.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Is minic is fusa focail scríofa a thuiscint ná focail ráite. Tá sé sin fíor go háirithe i gcás seoltaí, a bhíonn deacair a fhuaimniú go minic ar shlí a dtuigfí iad.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Tá roinnt tíortha go hiomlán líofa sa Bhéarla agus i níos mó is féidir leat a bheith ag súil le go bhfuil beagán acu - i measc daoine óga ach go háirithe.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Samhlaigh, más mian leat, duine as Manchain, Bostún, Iamáice agus Sydney ina suí timpeall an bhoird ag dinnéar i mbialann i Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Tá siad ag tabhairt údar gáire dá chéile le scéalta ón mbailte dúchais, agus iad á n-insint ina dtuin chainte ar leith agus i mbéarlagair na háite.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Is é an modh is saoire le hithe ná bia a cheannach in ollmhargaidh. Mura mbíonn deiseanna cócaireachta ann, áfach, níl mórán roghanna eile seachas bia réamhullmhaithe.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Tá na hollmhargaí ag soláthar réimse níos mó de bhia réamhdhéanta de réir a chéile. I gcuid acu, cuirtear oigheann micreathonn nó bealaí eile ar fáil chun bia a théamh.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: I roinnt tíortha nó cineálacha siopaí bíonn bialann amháin ar a laghad ar an láthair, go minic ceann neamhfhoirmiúil ar phraghsanna réasúnta.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Déan cóipeanna do do pholasaí agus sonraí teagmhála d'árachóir agus breith leat iad.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ní mór dóibh ríomhphost an árachaí a thaispeáin mar aon le huimhreacha fóin idirnáisiúnta le haghaidh comhairle/údarú agus chun éilimh a dhéanamh.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Coinnigh cóip eile i do chuid bagáiste agus ar líne (ríomhphost le ceangaltán seolta chugat féin, nó cóip stóráilte sa "néal").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Má tá tú ag taisteal le ríomhaire glúine nó táibléad, stóráil cóip sa chuimhne nó ar dhiosca (inrochtana gan an t-idirlíon).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Ina theannta sin, tabhair cóipeanna den pholasaí/de na sonraí teagmhála do chomrádaithe taistil agus gaolta nó cairde atá sa bhaile agus atá sásta cabhrú leat.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Níl mús (ar a dtugtar fia mór fosta) trodach go nádúrtha ach déanfaidh siad iad féin a chosaint má bhraitheann siad go bhfuil bagairt ann.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Nuair nach dóigh le daoine go bhféadfadh mús a bheith contúirteach, is féidir go rachaidh siad róghar dó agus go gcuirfidh siad iad féin i gcontúirt.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Bí measartha faoin méid alcóil a ólann tú. Téann alcól i bhfheidhm ar gach duine ar bhealach difriúil, agus tá sé an-tábhachtach fios do theorann féin a bheith agat.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: I measc na n-imeachtaí fadtéarmacha sláinte a d’fhéadfadh leanúint as ró-ól tá damáiste ae agus fiú daille agus bás. Méadaítear an chontúirt a d’fhéadfadh a bheith ann nuair a óltar alcól a táirgeadh go mídhleathach.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Is féidir salachair chontúirteacha éagsúla a bheith i mbiotáille neamhdhleathach lena n-áirítear meatánól, a d’fhéadfadh a bheith ina chúis de dhaille nó bás fiú i ndáileoga beaga.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Is féidir go mbeidh spéaclaí níos saoire i dtír eachtrach, go háirithe i dtíortha ar ioncam íseal ina mbíonn na costais saothair níos ísle.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Smaoinigh ar thástáil súl a dhéanamh sa bhaile, go háirithe má chlúdaítear é sin le hárachas, agus tabhair leat an oideas lena chomhlíonadh áit éigin eile.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Baineann dhá fhadhb leis na frámaí hainmbhrandaithe ardleibhéal sna réimsí seo; cuid acu ina leaganacha saora, agus na cinn atá iompórtáilte a bhíonn níos daora ná na cinn sa bhaile.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Tá caife ar cheann de na tráchtearraí is mó a thrádáiltear ar domhan, agus is dócha go bhfaighidh tú go leor cineálacha de i do réigiún féin.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Mar sin féin, tá go leor bealaí sainiúla ar fud an domhain le caife a ól, ar fiú iad a thriail.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Is éard is cainneonaíocht ann (nó: canyoneering) ná dul thíos ag bun cainneoin, atá tirim nó lán le huisce.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Leis an gcainneonaíocht tugtar le chéile gnéithe de shnámh, dreapadóireacht agus léimneach--ach is sách beag é an méid traenála nó obair fhisiciúil a bhíonn de dhíth chun tosú uirthi (i gcomparáid le hailleadóireacht, tumadóireacht scúba nó sciáil Alpach, mar shampla).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Is gníomhaíocht lasmuigh é siúlóireacht ina mbíonn duine ag siúl sa timpeallacht nádúrtha, go minic ar chonair shiúlóireachta.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Baineann siúlóireacht lae le faid a d'fhéadfadh a bheith níos lú ná míle amháin nó suas le faid níos faide ar féidir leo a dhéanamh laistigh d'aon lá amháin.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Ní gá mórán á ullmhú do lá siúlóireachta ar chonair éasca, agus is féidir le haon duine atá measartha aclaí sult a bhaint astu.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Is féidir go mbeidh breis ullmhúchán i gceist le teaghlaigh a bhfuil leanaí acu, ach is éasca lá amuigh a chaitheamh fiú in éineacht le babaí agus páistí réamhscoile.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Go hidirnáisiúnta, tá beagnach 200 eagraíocht turas reatha ann. Bíonn an chuid is mó acu ag feidhmiú go neamhspleách.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Cuireann Go Running Tours, a tháinig i gcomharbacht ar Global Running Tours, líonra ar fáil de na scórtha soláthraithe rith amhairc ar cheithre ilchríoch.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Bhí fréamhacha aige i Running Tours Barcelona agus i Running Tours Cóbanhávan, mar sin níorbh fhada gur tháinig Running Tours Prág atá lonnaithe i bPrág agus grúpaí eile isteach leis.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Tá go leor rudaí le cur san áireamh sula dtéann tú ag taisteal agus fad a bhíonn tú ag taisteal in áit ar bith.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Nuair a bhíonn tú ag taisteal, bí ag súil nach mbeidh rudaí mar atá siad "sa bhaile". Beidh béasa, bia, trácht, lóistín, caighdeáin, teanga agus mar sin de difriúil ón áit ina gcónaíonn tú.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ní mór duit é seo a choinneáil i gcuimhne i gcónaí, chun díomá a sheachaint nó b’fhéidir déistin fiú, faoin tslí atá ag muintir an cheantair le rudaí a dhéanamh.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Tá gníomhaireachtaí taistil ar an bhfód ó bhí an 19ú haois ann. Rogha mhaith is ea gníomhaire taistil de ghnáth nuair a bhíonn turas le déanamh a sháraíonn taithí an taistealaí roimhe seo ar nádúr, ar chultúr, ar theanga nó ar thíortha ar ioncam íseal.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Cé go mbíonn formhór na ngníomhaireachtaí sásta déileáil le mórchuid na ngnáth áirithintí, déanann go leor gníomhaireachtaí sainchúram de chineálacha áirithe taistil, raon buiséid, nó cinn scríbe.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Is féidir go mbeadh sé níos fearr gníomhaire a úsáid a chuireann turais den chineál céanna in áirithe go minic.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Féach ar na turais atá á gcur chun cinn ag an ngníomhaire, cibé ar láithreán gréasáin nó i bhfuinneog siopa.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Más mian leat an domhan a fheiceáil gan mórán airgid a chaitheamh, ar riachtanas, stíl mhaireachtála nó dúshlán, tá bealaí áirithe ann chun é sin a dhéanamh.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Go bunúsach, tá dhá chatagóir ann: Bí ag obair agus tú i mbun taistil nó déan iarracht do chostais a shrianadh. Is ar an dara chatagóir a bheidh an t-alt seo dírithe.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Dóibh siúd atá sásta le compord, am agus intuarthacht a chur ar leataobh le costais a laghdú go dtí beagnach a náid, féach ar thaisteal ar bhuiséad íosta.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Glactar leis sa chomhairle nach ndéanann taistealaithe goid, treaspás, a bheith páirteach sa mhargadh neamhdhleathach, airgead a iarraidh nó daoine a dhúshaothrú ar shlí ar bith eile ar mhaithe leo féin.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: De ghnáth is é an seicphointe inimirce an chéad stad ar theacht amach ó eitleán, long nó feithicil eile.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Ar roinnt traenacha trasteorann déantar cigireachtaí ar an traein reatha agus ba cheart go mbeadh comhartha aitheantais bailí agat agus tú ag dul ar bord ceann de na traenacha sin.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Ar thraenacha codlata, is féidir go mbaileoidh an bailitheoir ticéad na pasanna ionas nach mbrisfear isteach ar do chodladh.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Is riachtanas breise é an clárú don phróiseas víosa. I dtíortha áirithe, ní mór do láithreacht agus an seoladh ag a bhfuil tú ag fanacht a chlárú leis na húdaráis áitiúla.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: D'fhéadfadh sé bheith riachtanach foirm a líonadh isteach sa stáisiún póilíní áitiúil nó cuairt a thabhairt ar an oifig inimirce.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: I gcuid mhór tíortha a bhfuil dlí den chineál sin acu, láimhseálfaidh óstáin áitiúla an clárú (déan cinnte é a iarraidh).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: I gcásanna eile, ní gá ach iad siúd a fhanann lasmuigh de chóiríocht turasóireachta a chlárú. Mar sin féin, bíonn an dlí i bhfad níos doiléire, mar sin faigh amach roimh ré.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Baineann an ailtireacht le dearadh agus tógáil foirgneamh. Is minic a bhíonn ailtireacht na háite an príomhrud a mheallann turasóirí chuig an áit.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Tá neart foirgnimh go hálainn le breathnú orthu agus is féidir leis an radharc ó fhoirgneamh ard nó fuinneog atá suite go cliste a bheith ina hábhar áilleachta.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Bíonn go leor i gcomhar idir an ailtireacht agus réimsí eile lena n-áirítear pleanáil uirbeach, innealtóireacht shibhialta, na healaíona maisiúla, dearadh intí agus dearadh tírdhreacha.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Toisc go mbíonn a lán pueblos suite in áiteanna iargúlta, ní aimseoidh tú mórán siamsaíocht oíche gan taisteal chuig Albuquerque nó Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Mar sin féin, tá deochanna ar fáil sa chuid is mó de na casaíní liostaithe thuas, agus bíonn siamsaíocht ó ainmneacha branda á thabhairt isteach acu (na cuid is mó atá mórthimpeall ar Albuquerque agus Santa Fe, go príomha).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Aire: don chuairteoir nach ón stát é, ní áiteanna maithe i gcónaí iad beáir na mbailte beaga anseo le bheith ag crochadh thart iontu.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Ar an gcéad dul síos, tá fadhbanna suntasacha i dtuaisceart Mheicsiceo Nua le tiomáint faoi thionchar an óil, agus bíonn líon na dtiománaithe ar meisce ard in aice le beáir na mbailte beaga.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Graifítí a thugtar ar mhúrmhaisiú nó ar scrábadh neamhiarrtha.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Ní feiniméan nua-aimseartha é ar chor ar bith, ach is dócha go samhlaíonn mórchuid daoine é le daoine óga a bhíonn ag loitiméireacht ar mhaoin phoiblí agus phríobháideach le spraephéint.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Sa lá atá inniu ann, áfach, tá ealaíontóirí graifítí atá seanbhunaithe, imeachtaí graifítí agus ballaí atá "dleathach". Is minic a bhíonn pictiúir ghraifítí sa chomhthéacs seo cosúil le saothair ealaíne seachas clibeanna doléite.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Scil a bhfuil an-tóir uirthi is ea caitheamh búmaraing agus bíonn fonn ar go leor turasóirí í a fhoghlaim.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Má tá fonn ort foghlaim conas búmarang a chaitheamh ionas go bhfilleann sé ar do lámh, féach chuige go n-oireann an búmarang atá agat chuige sin.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Go deimhin ní thagann formhór na búmarang atá ar fáil san Astráil ar ais nuair a chaitear iad. B'fhearr do thosaitheoirí gan triail a bhaint as caitheamh agus é gaofar
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Déantar Mias Hangi a chócaráil i bpoll te sa talamh.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Téitear an chlais le clocha te ó thine, nó in áiteanna áirithe déanann teas geoiteirmeach réimsí den talún te go nádúrtha.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Is minic a úsáidtear an hangi chun dinnéar rósta sa stíl traidisiúnta a chócaráil.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Gheofar hangi geoiteirmeacha in áiteanna in Rotorua agus is féidir samplaí de hangi eile a fheiceáil in Christchurch, Wellington, agus in áiteanna eile.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Tá dhá ghrád ag MetroRail ar thraenacha comaitéireachta istigh i agus thart ar Cape Town MetroPlus (ar a thugtar Céad Ghrád chomh maith) agus Metro (ar a thugtar Tríú Grád).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Tá MetroPlus níos compordaí agus níl sé chomh plódaithe ach tá sé giota beag níos daoire cé go bhfuil sé fós níos saoire na gnáththicéid mheitreo san Eoraip.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Bíonn carráistí MetroPlus agus Metro araon ag gach traein; is ag deireadh an traenach is gaire do Cape Town a bhíonn na carráistí MetroPlus i gcónaí.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Rudaí a iompar do dhaoine eile - Ná ligtear riamh do chuid bagáiste as do radharc, go háirithe agus tú ag dul trasna teorainneacha idirnáisiúnta.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Tá an baol ann go n-úsáidfear thú mar iompróir drugaí i ngan fhios duit féin, rud a tharraingeodh go leor trioblóide ort.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Áirítear air seo fanacht i scuaine, de bhrí gur féidir madraí bolaíochta drugaí a úsáid uair ar bith gan fógra.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Is dian iad na pionóis a ghearrtar i dtíortha áirithe fiú as an gcéad chion; ina measc tá pianbhreitheanna príosúin os cionn 10 mbliana nó bás.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Tarraingíonn málaí gan duine ina bhfeighil aird ó ghadaithe agus is féidir leo aird a tharraingt, leis, ó údaráis atá eaglach faoi bhagairtí buamála.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Sa bhaile, mar gheall ar an nochtadh seasta seo do na frídíní áitiúla, tá seans an-mhaith ann go bhfuil imdhíonacht agat orthu cheana.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Tá sé níos dóichí go mbeidh fadhbanna agat in áiteanna eile ar domhan, de bhrí nach mbeidh aon taithí ag do chorp ar an fhána baictéareolaíoch.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Is fíor, in aeráidí teo, go bhfásann baictéir níos tapa agus maireann siad níos faide taobh amuigh den chorp.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: As sin a thagann sciúrse Deilí Belly, Mallacht an Fharó, Díoltas Montezuma, agus lucht a bpáirte.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Mar a tharlaíonn le fadhbanna riospráide in aeráidí fuara, is minic a fhaightear fadhbanna stéige in aeráidí teo agus i bhformhór na gcásanna is crá croí ceart iad sin, ach ní bhaineann aon chontúirt mhór leo.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Má thaistealaíonn tú i dtír i mbéal forbartha den chéad uair - nó in áit nua den domhan - ná ceap nach féidir le suaitheadh cultúir a bheith ann.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Is iomaí taistealaí socair cumasach a fuair úire de thaisteal sa chuid sin den domhan atá i mbéal a forbartha an ceann is fearr orthu, áit ar féidir leis na hathruithe cultúrtha carnadh suas go gasta.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Go háirithe i do laethanta tosaigh, smaoinigh ar airgead maith a chaitheamh ar óstáin, bia agus seirbhísí atá ar stíl agus cáilíocht an Iarthair chun cabhrú leat dul i dtaithí ar chúrsaí.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ná cuirtear tocht nó pardóg ar an talamh le codladh ann i gceantair nach bhfuil eolas agat ar an bhfána áitiúil.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Tabhair leat cliabhán campa nó ámóg leat chun tú a choinneáil sábháilte ar nathracha, scairpeanna agus a leithéid, má bheartaíonn tú campáil lasmuigh.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Sa bhaile bain sult as caifé breá blasta ar maidin agus cupán tae fíogadáin a thugann suaimhneas san oíche.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Nuair a bhíonn tú ar saoire i do thír dhúchais, bíonn an t-am agat cineál a dhéanamh ort féin agus cúpla nóiméad a thógáil chun rud éigin speisialta a tharraingt.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Má tá fonn taiscéalaithe ort, bain triail as roinnt caoineoga nó sú nó a mheascadh:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: seans go dtiocfaidh tú ar dheoch shimplí ar féidir leat a dhéanamh don bhricfeasta nuair atá tú ar ais i do ghnáthamh laethúil.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Má tá cónaí ort i gcathair a bhfuil cultúr éagsúil óil ann, téigh chuig beáir nó tithe tábhairne i gcomharsanachtaí nach dtéann tú ann go minic leat.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Dóibh siúd nach bhfuil taithí acu ar bhéarlagair leighis, tá brí ar leith leis na focail ionfhabhtaíoch agus tógálach.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Is galar tógálach é galar a chuirtear faoi deara le pataigin, amhail víreas, baictéar, fungas nó seadáin eile.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Is galar tógálach é galar a scaiptear go héasca trína bheith cóngarach do dhuine ionfhabhtaithe.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Éilíonn roinnt rialtas go mbeidh cuairteoirí a thagann isteach nó áitritheoirí a imíonn vacsaínithe in aghaidh raon galar.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Is féidir go mbraithfidh na riachtanais seo go minic ar cad na tíortha ar thug taistealaí cuairt orthu nó a mbeartaítear cuairt a thabhairt orthu.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Ceann de bhuntáistí móra Charlotte, Carolina Thuaidh, ná go bhfuil flúirse roghanna ardchaighdeáin ann do theaghlaigh.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Is minic a luann cónaitheoirí ó cheantair eile cairdiúlacht na dteaghlach mar phríomhchúis le bogadh ansin, agus is minic a bhíonn sé éasca ar chuairteoirí taitneamh a bhaint as an gcathair le leanaí mórthimpeall.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Le 20 bliain anuas, tá méadú as cuimse tagtha ar líon na roghanna atá oiriúnach do leanaí in Uptown Charlotte.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ní gnách do theaghlaigh in Charlotte tacsaithe a úsáid, cé gur féidir leo a bheith úsáideach i gcásanna áirithe.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Gearrtar formhuirear má tá níos mó ná 2 phaisinéir agat, mar sin d’fhéadfadh an rogha seo a bheith níos costasaí ná mar is gá.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Is í Antartaice an áit is fuaire ar Domhan, agus í cruinnithe thart ar an bPol Theas.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Tá costas mór ar chuairteanna turasóireachta, is gá a bheith corpacmhainneach chucu, ní féidir iad a dhéanamh ach amháin sa samhradh idir Samhain agus Feabhra agus is ar an Leithinis, sna hOileáin agus ar Muir Rois go príomha a dhéantar iad.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Tuairim is ceithre dosaen bunáiteanna atá suite sna limistéir sin ina bhformhór agus cónaíonn foireann de chúpla míle duine iontu sa samhradh; fanann líon beag daoine tríd an ngeimhreadh.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Is ardchlár tréigthe é Antartaice intíre atá clúdaithe le 2-3 km oighir.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Téann turais aeir speisialtóra isteach faoin tír ó am go chéile, le haghaidh sléibhteoireachta nó chun an Mol, a bhfuil bunáit mhór ann, a bhaint amach.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Is rian 1600 km ó Stáisiún McMurdo ar Mhuir Rois go dtí Trasbhealach (nó Mórbhealach) an Mhoil Theas.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Is sneachta brúite é le creabháis líonta isteach agus marcáilte le bratacha. Ní féidir é a bhaint amach ach le tarracóirí speisialaithe, sleamhnáin tarraingthe le breosla agus soláthairtí.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Níl siad ró-aclaí mar sin caithfidh an rian casadh fada a thógáil timpeall na Sléibhte Trasartacha chun an t-ardchlár a shroicheadh.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Is iad bóithre, cosáin agus céimeanna sleamhain (ach go háirithe) an chúis is coitianta le timpistí sa gheimhreadh.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Mar bhunriachtanas, beidh coisbheart déanta le boinn chuí de dhíth ort. Is iondúil gó mbíonn bróga samhraidh an-sleamhain ar oighear agus sneachta, ní sásúil cuid de na buataisí geimhridh fiú amháin.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Ba chóir don phátrún a bheith domhain go leor, 5 mm (1/5 orlach) nó níos mó, agus an t-ábhar bog go leor i dteochtaí fuara.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Tá stodaí ar bhuataisí áirithe agus tá trealamh breise stodaí ann do dhromchlaí sleamhain, a oireann d'fhormhór na mbróg agus na mbuataisí, le cur ar na sála nó ar na sála agus ar na boinn.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Ba chóir sála ísle agus leathana a chaitheamh. Scaiptear gaineamh, gairbhéal nó salainn (clóiríd chailciam) go minic ar bhóithre nó ar chosáin le tarraingt dhromchlach a fheabhsú.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Ní mínormáltacht atá i gceist le maidhmeanna sneachta; ní féidir ach méid áirithe sneachta a choinneáil ar fhánaí géara, agus titfidh méideanna iomarcacha síos mar mhaidhmeanna sneachta.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: An fhadhb ná gur substaint ghreamaitheach é an sneachta, mar sin bíonn truicearadh áirithe de dhíth uaidh le titim anuas, agus is féidir le roinnt sneachta a thagann anuas a bheith ina ócáid truicearaithe don chuid eile.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Uaireanta is é an ghrian ag téamh an sneachta an teagmhas a chuireann tús leis, uaireanta sneachta eile a thiteann, uaireanta eile imeachtaí nádúrtha eile, ar daoine a spreagann iad go minic.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Colún aeir ar bhrú an-lag agus a rothlaíonn is ea tornádó, a shúnn an t-aer ina thimpeall isteach agus suas in airde.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Gineann siad gaotha arda (ag 100-200 míle san uair, uaireanta) agus is féidir leo rudaí troma a ardú san aer, agus iad a iompar sa treo ina mbogann an tornádó.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Tosaíonn siad mar thonnadóirí ag teacht anuas ó néalta stoirme, agus iompaíonn siad ina "tornádónna" nuair a dhéanann siad teagmháil leis an talamh.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Is bealach iontach iad soláthraithe pearsanta VPN (líonra príobháideach fíorúil) chun cinsireacht pholaitiúil agus geoscagadh IP tráchtála a shárú.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Tá siad níos fearr ná seachfhreastalaithe ar chúiseanna éagsúla: Déanann siad gach trácht idirlín, ní amháin http, athródú.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Is gnách dóibh bandaleithead níos mó agus seirbhís ar chaighdeán níos airde a thairiscint. Tá siad criptithe agus mar sin tá sé níos deacra spiaireacht a dhéanamh orthu.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Is gnách do na cuideachtaí meán bréaga a insint faoin gcuspóir atá leis seo, ag maíomh go ndéantar é chun "píoráideacht a chosc".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: I ndáiríre, ní bheidh tionchar ar bith ag cóid réigiúin ar chóipeáil mhídhleathach; oibreoidh cóip giotán ar ghiotán de dhiosca go breá ar ghléas a oibreoidh an bhunchóip.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: An cuspóir atá leis ná tuilleadh smachta a thabhairt do na cuideachtaí sin ar a gcuid margaí; airgead a bheith i gcúrsaíocht an rud is tábhachtaí.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Toisc go dtreoraítear glaonna tríd an Idirlíon, ní gá duit úsáid a bhaint as comhlacht teileafóin atá lonnaithe i d'áit chónaithe, nó mar a dtaistealaíonn tú.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.
